Short notes to uploading your first vrchat avatar.
First read through the getting started guide from vrchat.
After you have installed the Creator Companion and Unity you can create your avatar project.
VRChat Creator Companion - Create Avatar Project Screen
Before opening the created project we will check the installed packages with the "Manage Project" Button.

In the Manage Packages View you can add Tools to Unity at the beginning "Official" and "Curated" Repositories should be available for you.
We will add more repositories for more tools.
VRChat Creator Companion - Install package repositories
For adding outfits to avatars there are usually two tools.
In this guide we will be using Modular Avatar by using the "Download (using VCC)"-Button.

Most outfits you will find are using extra shaders instead of the default Unity shaders.
The most common you will see are lilToon and Poiyomi.
Some are included in the outfit unity package but i find it better to manage these shaders with VCC(VRChat Creator Companion).
Both of them have an VCC install button on their website.
Here are some optional tools which improve the avatar creation process.

"Avatar 3.0 Emulator" is a tool to test your radial menu inside of unity.
It can be added with VCC.

"d4rkAvatarOptimizer" is a tool to merge skinned meshes and reduce the material count.
I usually just use the default settings as it is.
"MeshDeleterWithTexture beta" is a tool to remove mesh without having to use blender. You can just draw on the texture to select the parts to delete.

"Thry's Avatar Performance Tools" is a tool to display Performance Information of your avatar. I use it for finding large texture if i want to optimize the VRAM usage of my avatar.

There are multiple ways to find avatars. I usually use booth or boothplorer for searching for specific outfits.
Boothplorer has section for free avatars. There are some really nice ones so have a look at them.

First you will have to import the unity package of your avatar and outfit into unity.
Drag and drop the .unitypackage file into the unity window.
If the unity package includes lilToon or a other shader which you already added with VCC you should uncheck them in the import window.
Unity Package Import - uncheck everything in packages

Next we will have to find the avatar prefab in your Project Tab.
It is your file explorer for your assets inside your unity project.
Usually you can search for the avatar name and find it.

Drag the prefab into the Scene Hierarchy.
The Hierarch is a list of all gameobjects in the current scene.
Unity - Drag Avatar Prefab into Hierarchy

To upload the avatar you will need the VRChat SDK Panel.
In the Panel you will have to login, set a name and a thumbnail picture before being able to upload.

If you have an outfit with Modular Avatar you can drag the outfit prefab into the avatar prefab.
Then right click the outfit and select "Modular Avatar > Setup Outfit"
If the body of the avatar is clipping through the outfit you can adjust it with blendshapes.
With Modular Avatar you can create a toggle by right clicking on your avatar and selecting "Modular Avatar > Create Toggle".

It will create a gameobject in the hierarchy with a "MA Object Toggle" Component.
Here you can assign the gameobject you want to toggle.

First you will have to enable Avatar 3.0 Emulator in you scene.
This will add a gameobject to the root of your hierarchy with settings for the emulator.

Then you can click the unity play button above your scene window.
This will start the play mode of unity.
On your avatar will be a "Gesture Manager Av 3 Menu" with buttons which emulate the radial menu.
Add the component "D4rk Avatar Optimizer" to your avatar gameobject.
You can find the MeshDeleter in "GatoTool>MeshDeleter with Texture"
